name: Kagiyama Tarou
source:
Tarou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Makoto Narumi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. 

He is very serious, and hates it when people are disrespectful to his comrades. He also has a very strong sense of justice.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Taro_Kagiyama]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
